snippet.title: COP BASTARD | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
OSAKA. EARLY '90S. THE YAKUZA HAVE TAKEN OVER.

COP BASTARD is a fast, brutal, old-school FPS inspired by the gloriously over-the-top action movies of the '90s.

No puzzles. No perks. No upgrades.

Just tight corridors, relentless gunfights and the occasional spit in a thug's face.

You know. Police work.

💥 COP BASTARD ARRIVES OCTOBER 29, 2026! Coming to Steam and GOG.
